Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), pyuria (elevated leukocytes), hematuria, nitrites, and leukocyte esterase positivity. Glucosuria is noted, which may warrant further evaluation for glycemic status. Low urine specific gravity suggests dilute urine. No casts or ketones detected. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
